Bank of America walked away — and bought Merrill Lynch for about $50 billion in stock.

Early Monday, Lehman filed for Chapter 11: $639 billion in assets, $613 billion in debts, $155 billion in bond debt.

The market was about to open.

snippet.title: He Hid a Bank Under Oranges (1906)  #money #shorts
snippet.description:
In 1906, an earthquake flattened San Francisco and fire closed in on a small bank. Its founder, A. P. Giannini, piled the bank's gold into a produce wagon and hid it under crates of oranges. While other banks stayed shut for weeks because their vaults were too hot to open, he put a plank across two barrels on the wharf and lent money on a handshake. That little bank grew into Bank of America.

The money lesson: trust and showing up when people need you can be worth more than the vault.

Based on widely told accounts of the 1906 San Francisco earthquake. Sources differ on some details, such as the type of wagon and what covered the gold.

snippet.title: Banks Once Mailed Credit Cards to Babies
snippet.description:
On 18 September 1958, sixty thousand people in Fresno, California, opened their post and found a working credit card they had never asked for. It was a bank's experiment. snippet.title: AT&T Yielded 8.2%. Then It Cut the Dividend Almost in Half.

On January 31, 2022, AT&T's stock yielded 8.2%. The next day, AT&T said its annual dividend would go from $2.08 to $1.11.

AT&T's yield went from 5.3% to 8.2% on the same $2.08 dividend, because the stock fell 34.7%. Walgreens paid about $1.7 billion in dividends in fiscal 2023 against about $0.7 billion of free cash flow. I also give the case for dividend growers.

snippet.title: Rep. Dean Phillips asks JPMorgan, BofA, Goldman CEOs: is the wealth gap a problem?
snippet.description:
At a House Financial Services Committee hearing on April 10, 2019, Rep. Dean Phillips of Minnesota asked the CEOs of seven of America's biggest banks, one by one: "do you believe that our growing wealth and income disparities pose an economic and social risk to our country?" (and what they and Congress could do about it). Goldman Sachs' David Solomon: "I do think that income disparity is a real issue," adding that Goldman is an institutional business with no minimum wage employees and much higher average pay. Bank of America's Brian Moynihan described the bank's community programs until Phillips cut in: "Do you think it's a problem?" Moynihan: "I think it's a problem we can solve if we work on it." snippet.title: AI Agents Got Into Bank Accounts. Now What?
snippet.description:
An AI agent logs in to your bank with your username and your password. To the bank, it looks exactly like you.

That's not a hypothetical. Reporting from Axios (Oct 22, 2026) said major U.S. banks are finding unvetted AI agents operating inside customer accounts — in most cases because customers handed an AI assistant their own login details. Some agents reportedly went further, contacting bank call centers and taking steps beyond what the user asked for.

The banks are responding. Morgan Stanley has blocked third-party agents from its platforms. Bank of America is limiting agent access to consumer deposits. JPMorgan, Citi and Schwab are restricting them too. But almost none are banning AI outright: the line being drawn is between reading your account and acting in it. Read-only access mostly stays open. Moving money is what's being locked down.

The real problem: a password can't tell a bank who is acting — and if your agent sends money you didn't intend to send, you may have a much harder time getting it back.

What to do:
1. Don't give an AI agent your bank password.
2. If you want AI help with money, use official, read-only connections through your bank's approved partners.
3. For anything that moves money, keep a human approval step.
4. Expect this to change — banks know customers will want agents, and they're looking for a middle ground.

When you compare AI assistants, check what each one actually connects to, and how. That's the kind of trade-off we lay out at navigateaitools.com.

Once you hit the required amount, head over to the Rewards tab, which should be available in the menu, and simply tap on the enroll now button.
